name: Solarpunk Art Nouveau
about: Style test D. Optimistic future with Art Nouveau curves and botanical ornament, suited to Veridia's green, stone, quiet world. Described by its traits; no artist is named in the prompt.
prompt: Art Nouveau solarpunk illustration: flowing whiplash curves and botanical ornament, decorative framing of vines and leaves, poster-like flat color with fine elegant line, warm sunlit golden palette with greens and turquoise, harmonious high-tech organic architecture with solar glass, living walls and vertical gardens, elegant flowing garments, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

settings.veridia: Stone and living wood, sage, gold and cream, sunlight through leaves.
settings.dzego: Night version: glowing botanical shop fronts in pink, turquoise and amber, playful animal motifs in the ornament.
settings.united-cities: Glass and brass towers with green terraces.
settings.arctic: Frost-crystal ornament in white, silver and pale blue.
